description: Regional AR6 C1-C4 CCS rates in 2050 for a contextual figure benchmark.

selection.missing_category_policy: Exclude from C1-C4 benchmark; never infer a category.
selection.missing_rate_policy: Require finite nonnegative 2050 rates; no interpolation or imputation.
selection.zero_policy: Retain genuine zero rates; selected archived rows contain none.
selection.summary_weighting: Each available model-scenario outcome has equal weight within a jurisdiction.
selection.pooling: C1-C4 pooled regionally; no balancing of categories or model families.

jurisdiction_mappings.note: The source is country-labelled CCS output, not a basin-resolved geological estimate. Available model outcomes vary by country.
